run_one_inference_pipeline: run the full EFM3D inference pipeline on a VRS or WDS dataset with mesh fusion and evaluation
create_streamer_for_vrs_or_wds: create a data streamer from a VRS file or WDS tar folder with configurable snippet and stride length
compute_avg_metrics_from_json: compute average metrics across multiple JSON metric files by loading and averaging all key-value pairs
get_gt_mesh_ply_path: get the ground truth mesh PLY file path for a given data sequence from ADT or ASE directories
create_output_dir_for_results: create an output directory structured by model checkpoint name and data sequence name for inference results
